title: The British Empire
text: The British Empire was the largest empire in history, at its height in the early 20th century comprising about 24% of the world's total land area and governing about 412 million people — roughly one-quarter of the world's population. It originated with overseas possessions and trading posts established by England between the late 16th and early 18th centuries. Major territories included Canada, Australia, India, large parts of Africa, and numerous islands. The empire played a significant role in spreading the English language, common law, and parliamentary systems. Decolonization accelerated after World War II, and most territories gained independence by the 1970s. The Commonwealth of Nations is the successor organization to the British Empire.
